authorship.concept_category_rule: The frozen-ten rule, unchanged: the kind of move an option is, on one axis per set -- disease mechanism for a diagnosis set, what the test characterises for an investigation set, what is done to the milk for the lactation set, the target of the intervention for the supportive-care set, and source control for the strategy set.
authorship.discriminator_scoping_rule: The frozen-ten rule, unchanged. A discriminator is declared against the competitors it actually decides, and a feature two options share cannot decide between them -- which is why hypoxemia is scoped away from high-flow nasal cannula in G2-PED-03.
authorship.disjunction_reading_rule: The frozen-ten rule, unchanged. A clause list joined by 'or' is ANY_OF; clauses joined by 'and' that must hold of the same patient are ALL_OF; a disjunct with no feature in the frozen vocabulary is recorded in unmapped_disjuncts and never silently dropped.
authorship.no_role_override_was_needed: None of the six required a CLINICAL_JUDGEMENT feature to be retyped. Where a judgement feature is load-bearing it is left BACKGROUND_CONTEXT, and the consequence -- a competitor with no statable presentation anchor -- is reported rather than typed away.
authorship.what_is_not_changed: No opportunity, MCC objective, learner decision, difficulty intent, seed, evidence packet or frozen report moves. Every feature id is drawn from the frozen per-study-unit stem-feature vocabulary and every claim id from a frozen evidence packet. No new clinical claim is authored: every predicate carries the prose it is a reading of.
authorship.what_this_is: The authored semantic layer of the medium pilot: for each of the six frozen opportunities, a re-reading of the already frozen conditions_under_which_competitor_would_be_correct prose and of the cited evidence claims into a Boolean condition tree, plus the evidence-backed discriminators. Written before the supply wave and before any stem.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct where the pain is abrupt and maximal at onset, or where a pulse deficit, an inter-arm blood pressure difference or malperfusion findings are present.' Explicitly disjunctive. The V1 predicate list carried two disjuncts and dropped the malperfusion clause; SF-C21-END-ORGAN-HYPOPERFUSION is the frozen vocabulary's statement of it and CLM-AORTIC-DISSECTION-01 names malperfusion findings in the same breath as the pulse and blood-pressure differences, so it is restored rather than left unmapped.

Frozen seed: 'Correct where pretest probability is raised by sudden dyspnea, pleuritic pain, haemoptysis, hypoxemia or venous-thromboembolism risk factors, and the D-dimer or imaging pathway confirms it.' Two conjuncts joined by 'and'. Only the first has a feature in the frozen vocabulary; the confirmation pathway is recorded as an unmapped conjunct rather than silently dropped.

unmapped_disjuncts: the D-dimer or imaging pathway confirms it (CLM-PE-DIAGNOSIS-01); no frozen SU-C-21 feature states a completed PE confirmation pathway

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct where the pain is sharp, pleuritic and positional and the tracing shows widespread rather than territorial ST elevation or PR depression.' CLM-PERICARDITIS-01 reads the same way: the characteristic syndrome with supportive ECG findings. Two conjuncts.

CLM-ACS-DIAGNOSIS-01: suspected acute coronary syndrome is classified from the ischemic presentation, the ECG and cardiac troponin; new regional ST-segment depression or T-wave inversion supports NSTE-ACS and infarction requires acute myocardial injury in an ischemic context rather than an isolated troponin value. Two findings that must hold of the same patient, so a conjunction.

key_discriminators.scoping_reason: Scoped to the pulmonary embolism competitor alone. Dynamic regional ST- or T-wave change is not a feature pulmonary embolism carries in CLM-PE-DIAGNOSIS-01, whose plausibility list is sudden dyspnea, pleuritic pain, haemoptysis, hypoxemia and venous-thromboembolism risk factors, and whose pathway is D-dimer and imaging. It does not separate the key from pericarditis, which has its own ECG signature and is settled by the declared contradiction instead.
key_discriminators.statement: New regional ST-segment depression or T-wave inversion is what CLM-ACS-DIAGNOSIS-01 makes supportive of NSTE-ACS; the embolism pathway is decided by pretest probability with D-dimer or imaging, not by a territorial ECG change.

G2-MED-01.settlement_note: Pericarditis is settled without spending anything: the key's own required dynamic ST- or T-wave change is declared contradictory with widespread ST elevation and PR depression, so the second conjunct of its tree is defeated by a finding the item had to state anyway. Pulmonary embolism is settled by the same stated finding acting as an evidence-backed discriminator rather than by denying that its pretest probability is raised, which would be a meta-assertion about the decider. Dissection is the one this set cannot settle honestly, and the reason is recorded rather than engineered around.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct once a fluid collection is established, as the drainage step that achieves source control.' CLM-R4-OB-ABSCESS-DRAIN ties needle aspiration to an abscess, that is to an established collection. One condition.

Frozen seed: 'Correct where the skin findings of inflammatory breast cancer are present, or where a mass persists after complete resolution of inflammation and needs malignancy work-up.' Explicitly disjunctive; either alone makes the option right. CLM-R2-OB-IBC supplies the first disjunct.

CLM-R4-OB-PHLEGMON: phlegmon should be suspected with a history of mastitis that worsens into a firm, mass-like area without fluctuance, and it can be confirmed on ultrasound. CLM-R2-OB-ABSCESS-US adds that ultrasound may be used where an abscess is in question. Both conjuncts must hold of the same patient: the residual area, and the mastitis it arose from.

G2-OBGYN-02.settlement_note: Written before the supply wave and before the blueprint. The persistent-mass disjunct of the mammography tree is defeated for free, because the frozen contradiction list already makes a mass persisting after the inflammation has resolved incompatible with the systemic illness the key requires. What the set does not have is a third competitor.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Not correct: bacterial mastitis is not a contraindication to breastfeeding.' The frozen predicate layer states the same proposition positively: expressing and discarding is correct only where a contraindication to the infant receiving the milk is present. CLM-R2-OB-CONTINUE-FEEDING is the claim that mastitis is not one.

CLM-R2-OB-CONTINUE-FEEDING: it is safe for children to consume milk from a breast with bacterial mastitis and women should not be instructed to express and discard. CLM-R2-OB-NO-EMPTY: feed the infant on demand and do not aim to empty. Both cited claims are scoped to bacterial mastitis, which CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR states as a segmental erythematous painful breast with systemic signs. Two conjuncts.

G2-OBGYN-03.settlement_note: One competitor at freeze. The other four frozen seeds for this decision -- dangle feeding, pumping to empty, deep massage and a nipple shield -- are each recorded by their own frozen prose as never correct, and V2 requires every competitor to carry a condition under which it would be right. That is the finding this opportunity produces.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct as a monitored single trial where a clinical response would justify continuing, chiefly in the emergency department.' CLM-R4-PED-EPINEPHRINE separates the emergency-department admission question from the admitted patient, in whom a systematic review of nineteen studies shows no effect on length of stay. Two conjuncts.

Frozen seed: 'Correct where the respiratory rate makes oral feeding unsafe or the infant is dehydrated.' Both prose clauses resolve to the same frozen feature, which states unsafe oral intake or dehydration as one proposition, so the tree has one condition rather than a disjunction of two features. CLM-R4-PED-FEEDING is the claim behind it.

Frozen seed: 'Correct in moderate to severe disease where non-invasive support is needed to avert continuous positive airway pressure or intubation.' CLM-R4-PED-HFNC scopes the evidence to moderate and severe bronchiolitis. One condition, and it is the same feature this set's other two competitors carry as their anchor.

Frozen seed: 'Correct as an adjunct where nasal obstruction is limiting feeding or comfort, performed superficially and reasonably frequently.' CLM-R4-PED-SUCTION supplies the manner; the indication is the single condition.

CLM-R2-PED-DX-ANCHOR fixes the bronchiolitis phenotype as a first wheeze under twelve months after a two-to-three-day viral prodrome; CLM-R2-PED-OXYGEN makes oxygen the action when saturations fall below ninety percent. Three conjuncts: the patient the guidance is about, and the threshold that triggers it.

key_discriminators.scoping_reason: Scoped away from high-flow nasal cannula, which is itself an oxygen delivery device and shares the saturation as its own reason to be considered; a feature two options share cannot decide between them. Against the other three it decides: CLM-R2-PED-OXYGEN makes a saturation below the threshold the trigger for giving oxygen, CLM-R4-PED-FEEDING states that feeding is facilitated by providing supplemental oxygen rather than the other way round, and CLM-R4-PED-EPINEPHRINE leaves nebulized epinephrine without support in the admitted patient.
key_discriminators.statement: A saturation at or below the treatment threshold is what CLM-R2-PED-OXYGEN makes oxygen the answer to; nasogastric fluids, suctioning and nebulized epinephrine each address a different problem and none of them corrects the saturation.

G2-PED-03.settlement_note: Three of the four competitors are settled by the stated hypoxemia acting as an evidence-backed discriminator, which costs no denial and is what a HARD item is supposed to spend instead. High-flow nasal cannula is the structural problem in this set: escalating work of breathing is simultaneously its whole correctness condition and the only presentation anchor two other competitors have, so any stem that makes them live makes it correct.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct where a distinct and observable hypomanic period has occurred.' CLM-R2-PSY-BD-II reads the same way: hypomanic episodes qualitatively like manic periods, distinct and observable. One condition.

Frozen seed: 'Correct where two or more depressive symptoms have been present for more than two years.' CLM-R2-PSY-PDD states the two-year floor. The frozen predicate layer adds the second conjunct, that function did not return between episodes, which is what continuous presence means; both are kept.

CLM-R2-PSY-DX-ANCHOR makes the comprehensive diagnostic assessment the first step and reads the emotional, cognitive and somatic symptoms against a diagnostic framework; CLM-R2-PSY-PDD is the claim that separates the chronic course from the episodic one. Two conjuncts: a current syndrome, and full recovery between episodes.

G2-PSY-01.settlement_note: Persistent depressive disorder is settled for free: the key requires full interepisode recovery, which is the direct negation of the second conjunct of its tree and is already a declared contradiction against the chronic course. Bipolar II can only be settled by stating that no distinct hypomanic period is recorded, which is one explicit denial and is the whole of a MEDIUM item's budget.

correctness_conditions.prose_basis: Frozen seed: 'Correct where operative management is contraindicated or the disease is walled off and settles on antibiotics.' Explicitly disjunctive: either alone makes the strategy right. The V1 predicate layer carried both as conjuncts, which read a patient who must have both.

Frozen seed: 'Correct in selected adults with uncomplicated appendicitis who accept a cross-over and recurrence risk.' CLM-R2-SURG-NONOP is confined to adult uncomplicated appendicitis, with fifty-three percent crossing over within forty-eight hours. Two conjuncts: the selection, and the absence of the complication that ends the selection.

CLM-R2-SURG-STANDARD: appendectomy is the standard of care in adult appendicitis and is advocated by the American College of Surgeons, the Society for Surgery of the Alimentary Tract and the World Society of Emergency Surgery. Two conjuncts: the presentation that makes it appendicitis, and the clinical probability at which the operation is taken rather than deferred.

key_discriminators.scoping_reason: Scoped to the interval strategy, whose remaining disjunct is an operative contraindication. CLM-R2-SURG-DRAINAGE confines antibiotics alone and percutaneous drainage to disease with a phlegmon or a walled-off abscess; free perforation with generalised peritonitis is the case those claims exclude, and it is a positive examination finding rather than a denial written for the item.
key_discriminators.statement: Generalised peritonitis from free perforation is outside the disease CLM-R2-SURG-DRAINAGE allows to settle on antibiotics, and it is not a reason to defer the operation.

G2-SURG-03.settlement_note: A HARD item with no denial to spend. Both settlements are positive findings: perforation with generalised peritonitis is already declared contradictory with the uncomplicated-and-accepts-recurrence-risk conjunct the antibiotic strategy needs and with the walled-off collection the interval strategy needs, so one stated examination finding settles both trees and then serves as the cited discriminator against the interval strategy's remaining disjunct.
